name: Tsukinashi Maya
source:
The school nurse. She has the responsibility to care for the sick and injured but also makes certain that students are having sex and treating the monster girls with respect.

[spoiler]When she was a student it was found out that she was a succubus. This led to male students avoiding her thinking she was a slut. She now hides her demon nature believing she will never find love.[/spoiler]
